alt: Royal Love Story in a red frame with a white mat, lying on a black surface: a couple's faces, a diamond perfume bottle and a red heart.
description: A red frame with a wide white mat lies flat on black cloth, shot from above its bottom edge so it tapers toward the top. Inside, the collage shows a man and a woman cheek to cheek, a jewelled bottle over his eyes, a gilded theatre and an anatomical heart. The frame sits low and centre; the top fifth is dark clutter with a thin red and black stick across it, and the sides are empty black. The original only exists as a small file, so this is the only other view of the piece.
qualityNote: Direct flash and shot at an angle, so the frame is a trapezoid. The frame is only about 750 px wide in the 1600 file. Crop off the cluttered strip along the top.

alt: The Art of Art in a white frame on a black surface: blue sky and clouds, a butterfly on a yellow flower, cut-out words and a black feather.
description: A deep white frame lies on black cloth, seen at an angle from its lower edge. The collage inside is mostly bright blue sky with white clouds, a red and black butterfly on a yellow flower at the lower left, a black feather, and cut-out lettering in the middle. Empty black fills both sides; a stick crosses the top and a white ball peeks in at the right edge.
qualityNote: Flash, angled view, and a small glare spot on the glass at the lower right. A white ball at the right edge and a stick along the top need cropping out. Frame about 750 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Senor Tigre in a thin black frame on a black surface: a woman reading in a garden room with tigers beside her and along the bottom.
description: A thin black frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, so the frame almost disappears and the white mat reads as a glowing rectangle. The collage inside is small: a woman in a lounge chair in a glass garden room, a tiger leaning over her, and a row of tigers along the bottom. The top of the picture shows red stool legs and a warm wooden floor behind the surface; the rest is empty black.
qualityNote: The black frame merges into the black surface. The artwork is small in the picture (about 370 px wide in the 1600 file). Flash, angled view, and background clutter along the top.

alt: Zenda Beach in a red frame with a white mat on black: a figure in yellow striding over a crowded beach, blue denim shorts in the foreground.
description: A red frame with a white mat lies on plain black, seen at a slight angle and filling about half the width of the picture. The collage shows a pale beach dotted with sunbathers, an oversized figure in a yellow coat stepping across the horizon, and a close-up of denim shorts across the bottom. Clean black all round with no stray objects; the lettering on the denim is not legible.
qualityNote: Clean and sharp, but flash-lit and angled (the frame tapers toward the top). Frame about 830 px wide in the 1600 file, so keep it to a card or a half-width slot.

alt: Blues in a thin black frame on black: a white sports car in blue water, a figure standing in its roof, pale blue squares scattered above.
description: A thin black frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, left of centre, so the mat is what you see first. The collage is all blues and teals: a white sports car half in the sea with a woman standing up through the roof, another figure hanging at the top left, and a field of paper squares behind. The right third and the bottom are empty black. The original only exists as a small file, so this is the only other view of the piece.
qualityNote: The black frame is hard to tell from the black surface, and there is a pink cast across the top of the mat. Flash, angled view. Frame about 800 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: I Am the Bad Guy in a red frame on black: a figure with long blue hair seen from behind on a street, with men, boys and a roadside sign.
description: A red frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, shot at an angle and centred slightly left. The collage is busy and sharp: a figure with long blue hair and a varsity jacket seen from behind, a group of men and boys at the right, a small-town street with a soda sign, and fish under water in the top left corner. Black space on both sides; a thin stick runs along the very top edge.
qualityNote: Sharp. Flash-lit and angled; crop off the stick along the top edge. Frame about 800 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Small World in a thin black frame on black: two black-and-white fashion figures with hand-painted blue words, Keep your eyes to the sky.
description: A thin black frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, centred, with the white mat doing the framing. The collage is black and white with bright blue paint: one figure in a white suit raising an arm, another in a dark jacket on a cobbled street, blue stripes and hand-lettered words across the top. A thin stick runs across the top of the picture; the sides are empty black. The original only exists as a small file, so this is the only other view of the piece.
words: KEEP YOUR EYES TO THE SKY
qualityNote: The art is sharp, but the black frame is barely visible against the black surface. Flash, angled view, pink cast at the top of the mat. Frame about 800 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Curiosity in a deep white frame, set at an angle on a black surface: people seen from behind looking up at an old map with a red bag on it.
description: A deep white frame with a very wide white mat sits to the right of centre, turned so its right side runs off at an angle. The small collage inside shows four figures from behind looking up at an antique map, a wooden board with a red handbag and a small sign, and a feathered hat at the right. The left third of the picture is empty black, and a worn black stick with chipped paint lies across the bottom.
qualityNote: Off-centre and skewed, slightly soft, with a chipped stick across the bottom. The artwork is only about 380 px wide in the 1600 file. img-8838 is the better picture of the same framed piece.

alt: Curiosity in a deep white frame with a wide mat on black: figures from behind looking up at an antique map, a red handbag hanging above.
description: The same white-framed piece as img-8837, here centred and seen more squarely from its bottom edge. A wide white mat surrounds a small warm-toned collage: four people from behind studying an old map, a red handbag on a wooden board, a feathered hat and a painted figure at the right. Black on both sides; a worn black stick with chipped paint crosses the bottom of the picture.
qualityNote: Flash and angled view. The artwork is small inside the mat (about 390 px wide in the 1600 file). Crop off the chipped stick along the bottom.

alt: Artstract in a red frame on black: a blonde woman in a kitchen overtaken by playful orange, white and black shapes on a yellow ground.
description: A red frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, left of centre, tapering toward the top. Inside, the collage has a hand-painted yellow border; a blonde woman in a kitchen at the top dissolves into orange, white, green and black abstract creatures on yellow. The right third of the picture is empty black, and a chipped black stick lies along the bottom edge.
qualityNote: Sharp and bright. Flash-lit and angled; crop off the stick at the bottom edge. Frame about 730 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Stuck in a thin black frame on black: a dancer and fireworks above a wall of speakers, a man sitting cross-legged on sheet music below.
description: A thin black frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, and the frame is nearly lost in the dark. The collage inside is small and narrow: a dancer by a railing with fireworks at the top, a handwritten paper strip, grey speakers, and a man in a cap sitting cross-legged on sheet music. A stick and dark clutter run across the top; most of the picture is black.
qualityNote: Soft focus on the artwork (the handwritten line cannot be read), dark overall, and the artwork is only about 320 px wide in the 1600 file. Use the original instead.

alt: Female Cactus in a deep white frame on black: a tall green cactus with pink flowers rising from grey rock, with the words Wildlife sees it.
description: A deep white frame with a wide white mat lies on black, turned a few degrees clockwise and filling half the width. The collage is simple and graphic: one tall green cactus with pink blooms and spines on a white ground, grey rock along the bottom, two words at the top left. The brightest picture of the set, with clean black on both sides; a sliver of a chipped stick shows at the very bottom edge.
qualityNote: Sharp and reads well small. Flash-lit, angled and slightly rotated; trim the bottom edge to lose the stick. Frame about 800 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Day # 25 in a red frame on black: an illustrated blonde face with red lips on bright pink textured paper scattered with pale stars.
description: A red frame with a white mat lies on plain black, shot at an angle with its near corner toward the camera. The piece inside is almost all hot pink: textured pink paper with pale cut-out stars and three pink clouds, and a drawn blonde face with red lips in the lower middle. Clean black all round and nothing else in shot. The original only exists as a small file, so this is the only other view of the piece.
qualityNote: Clean. Flash-lit and angled (the frame tapers toward the top). Frame about 800 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Be You in a thin black frame on black: a woman in a pink satin dress covering her face, a rainbow flag, flowers and the words Be You.
description: A thin black frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, left of centre, so the white mat is what stands out. The collage is sharp and crowded: a woman in a pink satin dress with a hand over her face, a photographer above a rainbow flag at the left, two seated girls with pink hair at the right, flowers along the bottom. The right third is empty black, and a chipped stick shows along the very bottom edge.
qualityNote: The art is sharp, but the black frame merges into the black surface and the frame sits left of centre. Flash, angled view; trim the bottom edge. Frame about 830 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Gaga's Offering in a thin black frame on black: a figure in a red horned headpiece under purple stars, mirrored by a red figure below.
description: A thin black frame with a white mat lies on black cloth, left of centre and hard to see against the dark. The collage is red, purple and deep blue: a pale figure in a red horned headpiece under glitter stars, an upside-down red figure below, a sunset sky at the left. The right 40 percent of the picture is empty black, with sticks along the top and bottom edges.
qualityNote: The artwork is soft, the picture is dark, and there is a flash glare streak on the glass at the lower right. Use the original instead.

alt: Lucky Pleasures in a deep white frame on black: a figure in a tan bikini with red lips over the eyes, on hot pink, with a cigarette pack.
description: A deep white frame with a wide white mat lies on black cloth, centred and filling half the width. The collage shows a torso in a tan bikini with a pair of red lips placed over the eyes, hands reaching in from the right, a hot pink painted ground and a cigarette pack at the lower right. The mat hides the bottom strip of the piece, so the lettering along the bottom of the original is not visible here. A thin stick runs along the top edge.
qualityNote: The artwork is out of focus (the frame edges are sharper than the art), so keep it small. The mat crops the bottom of the piece. Flash, angled view.

alt: Reflections of Me in a deep white frame on black: a woman from behind in a black dress with a white snake, echoed by cut-out silhouettes.
description: A deep white frame with a wide white mat lies on plain black, turned a few degrees clockwise and filling half the width. The collage shows a woman from behind in a black dress with a white snake on it, fanned out on both sides by silhouettes cut from other photos, over a ground of tiny old portraits; a small blonde face sits in a pale blue arch at the bottom. Clean black around it and nothing else in shot.
qualityNote: Sharp. The flash slightly burns out the white frame, and the frame is a little rotated and angled. Frame about 840 px wide in the 1600 file.

alt: Candy in a red frame on black: a face with an orange bob and a psychedelic mouth sticker, pink blazer, a hand holding sweets.
description: A red frame with a white mat lies on plain black, centred and seen at a slight angle. The collage is the loudest of the set: a woman with a bright orange bob, a swirling sticker with red lips over her mouth, a pink blazer, round stickers on her neck, and a hand with red nails holding sweets, on a magazine cover with paint strokes. Clean black all round and nothing else in shot. The original only exists as a small file, so this is the only other view of the piece.
qualityNote: Sharp and clean. Flash-lit and angled (the frame tapers toward the top). Frame about 780 px wide in the 1600 file.
